entries.title: Full Standalone Migration
entries.description: After a long wait, Roam is finally standalone! We didn't really like where INDIE.FUN was headed, soo .. yeah. Long Live PvZ Roam!

entries.title: New Account Database
entries.description: Added a new account system separate from the former. Make new accounts here! Non-logged in users aren't able to experience the luxuries of datasaving.

entries.title: Modd/Indie Data Importing
entries.description: Added Data Importing to the 'More Info' tab on the account center on the top right. Have any issues? Contact me (@thw0k) or @.footsoldier on the Plants vs. Zombies: Roam Discord Server!
